_doc: Support gems (BUILD_DIRECTION 'Supports', BUILD_UNLOCKS level 12): items that slot into a skill to make fun combinations. A skill's socket 1 opens at its rank sockets.ranks[0], socket 2 at sockets.ranks[1]. Gems drop with bad-luck protection: each copy she owns multiplies that gem's drop weight by badLuck.perOwned, so the others come. fits: the skill tags a gem takes (empty = any skill). effects: summed per skill and read by the battle (wired after bd-keys lands). Read by Rpg/Supports.cs.

gems.name: Brutality
gems.text: Her blows hit 25% harder and lose their reach.

gems.name: Wide Arc
gems.text: The swing sweeps a third wider, a little lighter.

gems.name: Concussion
gems.text: What it strikes is stunned half a second longer.

gems.name: Bloodletting
gems.text: Its hits open a bleed for 30% of the blow.

gems.name: Bulwark
gems.text: While it plays she blocks one blow in five.

gems.name: Echo
gems.text: It repeats once, and waits a third longer to come back.

gems.name: Quickening
gems.text: It comes back a fifth sooner and hits a tenth lighter.
